surprises: Regenerating the ClickHouse schema folded in unrelated athletes_cache column drift (football_team_id, basketball_*, college_*), bundling a second table's schema change into this influencers commit.
The first smoke run failed and only passed on the second attempt, so the query matrix was not green on the first pass.
The committed openapi.generated.json now exposes /app/influencers because the onRoute hide:true hook only affects the runtime spec, not the generated snapshot.

proposed_rules.diff: + Smoke cases assert only that a query executes and returns the expected row shape; never assert on the current warehouse population (e.g. that some rows carry empty city/country/age_group). Assert value transforms like empty->null on a fixture row in a mapper unit test instead — population assertions flake on ingestion changes.

+ The CTE-schema-extension machinery (typed Ctes plus the `as unknown as Database` cast) belongs in the database layer under src/lib/database.ts, shared across modules — do not copy a per-module InfluencerCtes/InfluencerDatabase cast into each route module.

followups: P2: Rework the list-influencers 'empty-value' smoke case to assert the mapper's empty->null transform on a fixture row rather than pinning to the current warehouse population.
P3: Unify the influencers and artists module CTE casts onto a shared helper in src/lib/database.ts instead of per-module `as unknown` casts.
P3: Confirm the committed openapi.generated.json exposing /app/influencers (alongside /app/athletes and /app/artists) is intended for the generated artifact.
